_comment: Single source of truth for the seed desirability score. Read by score.js (GUI), score.zig (generator), and scripts/plot_distributions.py. SIGNED scale [-100,100], 0=par: score = round(sum(weight * component)). Each component maps its metric to a signed value centred on its median (lo/hi), with an odd-power emphasis (exp). kind 'signed' spans [-100,100]; kind 'bonus' is one-sided [0,100] (a floor value contributes 0, only high values lift). Edit weights/lo/hi and re-run the plotter to retune; the generator picks it up via SCORE_CONFIG (no rebuild).
